FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.Name: Ground patches
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.dirt.Tooltip: Bare, trodden earth (terrain paint) with a few dirt marks.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.mown.Tooltip: Tidy ovals of short grass with a clean edge.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.meadow.Toolti: Long grass with wildflowers, softly blended into the lawn.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.rocky.Tooltip: Stony ground with a group of rocks: big stones in the middle, small ones around.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.gravel.Toolti: A gravel surface in a blended halo.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.sand.Tooltip: A sand surface in a blended halo.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.arrange.Toolt: Scattered over open ground, a drift along the park's length, along the edges, or a cluster of touching patches.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.finish.Toolti: Automatic: each kind its natural look. Paint: terrain paint only. Surface: a surface inside every painted patch.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.blend.Tooltip: Width of the soft border where a patch fades into the ground around it.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.roughness.Too: How irregular the outlines are (0 % = smooth ovals).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.pathTo.Toolti: Join dirt, gravel, sand and mown patches to the nearest path.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.wildflowers.T: Low bushes scattered through meadow patches.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Ground.dirtLayer.Too: Terrain texture layers 1–4 depend on the map; pick the one that looks right for each kind.
